parameters.jsonBody:
={
 "model": "openrouter/free",
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": {{ JSON.stringify(
        "Analyze this research paper.

" +
        "Title: " + $json.title + "

" +
        "Authors: " + $json.authors + "

" +
        "Published: " + $json.published + "

" +
        "Abstract:
" + $json.abstract + "

" +
        "Give the answer in a clean and simple format.

" +
        "KEY FINDINGS:
" +
        "- List the important findings as simple bullet points.

" +
        "METHODS USED:
" +
        "- List the research methods as simple bullet points.

" +
        "DATASETS:
" +
        "- List the datasets or data sources as simple bullet points.

" +
        "RESEARCH GAPS:
" +
        "- List the research gaps as simple bullet points.

" +
        "SUMMARY:
" +
        "Write a clear 3-5 sentence summary.

" +
        "If something is not specified, write Not specified.
" +
        "Do not include reasoning or extra explanations."
      ) }}
    }
  ]
}

={{
  {
    model: "nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free",

    response_format: {
      type: "json_object"
    },

    messages: [
      {
        role: "user",
        content:
          "Compare these research papers.\n\n" +

          "PAPERS:\n" +
          JSON.stringify($json.papers, null, 2) +
          "\n\n" +

          "Analyze all papers carefully.\n" +
          "Compare their findings, methods, datasets, differences, limitations, research trends, and unresolved research areas.\n\n" +

          "IMPORTANT:\n" +
          "Do not treat a problem mentioned in a paper as a research gap automatically.\n" +
          "Do not simply repeat the abstract.\n" +
          "Only identify an unresolved research gap when it is supported by evidence from the papers.\n" +
          "Clearly distinguish limitations from genuine research gaps.\n" +
          "If there is not enough evidence, write Not specified.\n\n" +

          "Return ONLY valid JSON.\n" +
          "Do not include reasoning.\n" +
          "Do not include markdown.\n" +
          "Do not include ```json.\n\n" +

          "Use exactly these fields:\n" +
          "{\n" +
          "  \"common_findings\": \"\",\n" +
          "  \"methods_comparison\": \"\",\n" +
          "  \"dataset_comparison\": \"\",\n" +
          "  \"key_differences\": \"\",\n" +
          "  \"common_limitations\": \"\",\n" +
          "  \"research_trends\": \"\",\n" +
          "  \"overall_comparison_summary\": \"\"\n" +
          "}"
      }
    ]
  }
}}

={{
  {
    model: "nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free",

    messages: [
      {
        role: "user",

        content:
          "Identify the overall research gap from the comparison of these research papers.\n\n" +

          "PAPER COMPARISON:\n" +
          JSON.stringify($json, null, 2) +
          "\n\n" +

          "IMPORTANT RESEARCH GAP RULES:\n" +
          "1. Do not simply repeat a problem mentioned in the papers.\n" +
          "2. Do not treat every limitation as a research gap.\n" +
          "3. Identify an unresolved gap only when supported by the comparison.\n" +
          "4. Look for what existing approaches still fail to address adequately.\n" +
          "5. Prefer gaps that appear across multiple papers or reveal a clear missing capability.\n" +
          "6. If the evidence is insufficient, write Not specified.\n" +
          "7. Do not invent facts, datasets, methods, or limitations.\n\n" +

          "Return ONLY valid JSON with exactly these fields:\n" +
          "{\n" +
          "  \"overall_research_gap\": \"\",\n" +
          "  \"evidence_from_papers\": \"\",\n" +
          "  \"why_this_gap_matters\": \"\",\n" +
          "  \"confidence\": \"High/Medium/Low\"\n" +
          "}\n\n" +

          "Do not include reasoning.\n" +
          "Do not include markdown.\n" +
          "Do not include ```json."
      }
    ]
  }
}}

={{
  {
    model: "nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free",

    messages: [
      {
        role: "user",

        content:
          "Develop a proposed research direction based on the identified overall research gap.\n\n" +

          "OVERALL RESEARCH GAP:\n" +
          JSON.stringify($json, null, 2) +
          "\n\n" +

          "Your task is to propose a realistic and research-worthy direction that directly addresses this gap.\n\n" +

          "IMPORTANT:\n" +
          "1. The proposed direction must directly address the identified research gap.\n" +
          "2. Do not simply repeat existing papers.\n" +
          "3. Do not invent unsupported results.\n" +
          "4. Clearly explain what would be new or improved.\n" +
          "5. If a dataset is not known or cannot be confidently recommended, write Not specified.\n\n" +

          "Return ONLY valid JSON with exactly these fields:\n" +
          "{\n" +
          "  \"proposed_research_topic\": \"\",\n" +
          "  \"research_objective\": \"\",\n" +
          "  \"proposed_methodology\": \"\",\n" +
          "  \"possible_datasets\": \"\",\n" +
          "  \"expected_contribution\": \"\",\n" +
          "  \"potential_novelty\": \"\",\n" +
          "  \"evaluation_plan\": \"\"\n" +
          "}\n\n" +

          "Do not include reasoning.\n" +
          "Do not include markdown.\n" +
          "Do not include ```json."
      }
    ]
  }
}}

={{
  {
    model: "nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free",

    messages: [
      {
        role: "user",
        content:
          "Create a professional academic research literature review report using ONLY the supplied research data.\n\n" +

          "RESEARCH DATA:\n" +
          JSON.stringify($json, null, 2) +
          "\n\n" +

          "REPORT STRUCTURE:\n" +
          "1. Title\n" +
          "2. Executive Summary\n" +
          "3. Papers Reviewed\n" +
          "4. Cross-Paper Comparison\n" +
          "5. Overall Research Gap\n" +
          "6. Evidence Supporting the Research Gap\n" +
          "7. Proposed Research Direction\n" +
          "8. Research Objective\n" +
          "9. Proposed Methodology\n" +
          "10. Possible Datasets\n" +
          "11. Expected Contribution\n" +
          "12. Potential Novelty\n" +
          "13. Evaluation Plan\n" +
          "14. Conclusion\n\n" +

          "WRITING REQUIREMENTS:\n" +
          "- Write in professional academic English.\n" +
          "- Use clear headings and subheadings.\n" +
          "- Present the reviewed papers clearly.\n" +
          "- Compare the papers based on findings, methods, datasets, limitations, and trends.\n" +
          "- Clearly distinguish existing evidence from the proposed research direction.\n" +
          "- Do not invent facts, results, citations, datasets, or claims.\n" +
          "- If information is unavailable, write 'Not specified'.\n" +
          "- The research gap must be evidence-based and should not simply repeat a problem statement.\n" +
          "- The proposed research direction must directly address the identified gap.\n\n" +

          "OUTPUT:\n" +
          "- Return ONLY Markdown.\n" +
          "- Do not include JSON.\n" +
          "- Do not include ```markdown or other code fences."
      }
    ]
  }
}}
